label: Smith refuted Hobbes's psychological egoism, asserting that natural sympathy and benevolence are foundational to human social life
description: Adam Smith engaged in a direct critique of Thomas Hobbes's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Thomas Hobbes's perspective to Adam Smith's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Early Modern & Scientific across history into the Enlightenment & Social Contract.
